scope: Ordinary UTF8 encode and String scalar edits; complete standard library/ZUI not claimed

commands.command: cargo clippy --locked --offline -p zil-driver --features llvm-api --test impl236_zui_core -- -D warnings

binding.algorithm: SHA256 of sorted path + NUL + file SHA256 + LF
binding.paths: Cargo.lock, Cargo.toml, tracked lib/**, crates/**/src/**, crate Cargo.toml/build.rs

native.unicode_scalar_domain: 0..0x10FFFF excluding 0xD800..0xDFFF, actual encode/decode loop in each native executable

controls: Invalid scalar/out-of-range/surrogate and short output preserve sentinel bytes
Exact emoji bytes; owned substring remains independent after original truncation and clear
Error propagation checked through actual success marker; invalid requests preserve original length and capacity
Existing String, Store fault-injection cleanup and iterator consumers remain unchanged
limitations: No full Unicode normalization/grapheme/locale or complete collection claim
No native Windows or cost benchmark claim
